# Publish gate report

**Going out:** a review blog post with an affiliate link to Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience. No send time was given.

**Checks run**
- **Claims:** "the tins are lovely" is opinion and fine. "Pebblebrook's was the easiest to pause" is a comparison against three unnamed rivals, and the policy has no source for it. The policy only backs "subscribers can pause or cancel any time". I couldn't verify "four tea subscriptions this year" either. It reads as the author's own experience, so I've left it.
- **Regulated claims:** none apply. There's no health, money, environmental or price content.
- **House style:** no banned words or AI tells. It's short and plain.
- **Disclosure:** this fails. The affiliate note is a footnote at the very end, after the link. For UK rules (ASA/CMA) it needs to come before the reader engages, in plain words, and the link itself should be marked. "I may earn" is also vaguer than it should be, since you know you earn if they buy.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite)**
- Moved the disclosure to the top, in plain words.
- Marked the link as an affiliate link.
- Replaced the "easiest" comparison with the policy-backed fact plus personal experience.

> Affiliate disclosure: the link in this post is an affiliate link, so I earn a commission if you buy through it.
>
> I've tried four tea subscriptions this year. Pebblebrook lets you pause any time, and I found it simple to do. The tins are lovely. You can find it here (affiliate link).

**Needs a decision**
1. Did you really try four subscriptions this year? Please confirm, because I can't check it. If not, cut that line.
2. Was the Pebblebrook subscription gifted or discounted? If so, that needs disclosing too. I suggest adding "Pebblebrook sent me this subscription for free" at the top.
3. If you want to keep "easiest to pause", you'd need a source for the comparison. I suggest dropping it.

**Approver:** the policy names no approver, so I need an explicit yes from you on the exact revised text above. Until then it shouldn't go out.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "I've tried four tea subscriptions this year.", "type": "missing_disclosure"}, {"quote": "easiest to pause", "type": "superlative"}], "publish": false}
```
